pages.text: $(bold)Ability-slot modifier - Aristocratic Dining$(): we deserve the gift of tasting food!(br2)Restriction: $(l)armor only$(); $(bold)no levels$(), costs $(bold)1 ability slot$().(br2)Requirement: the wearer must be a $(bold)vampire of level 5 or higher$() (Vampirism vampire faction level >= 5; hunters do not count).

$(bold)Effect$(): when eating $(bold)normal food$(), you regain hunger as usual $(italic)and$() gain blood equal to the food's $(bold)nutrition value$() - the blood saturation uses the very same formula Vampirism uses for its own food.(br2)Notes: blood bottles / blood potions / pure blood have no food properties and do not count; a broken piece of armor (tic_broken) disables the modifier.(br2)Recipe: $(bold)a full blood bottle$() (blood bottle with damage 0) + Vampire Orchid + Vampire Blood Bottle + $(bold)Pure Blood of purity 3 or higher$().
